title: tuikit terminal catalog
description: Components a terminal can draw well, for A2UI v0.9 surfaces rendered by github.com/keyolk/tuikit/surface. Styling is semantic only.

Column.description: Children stacked top to bottom. One-line children keep their height; List, Table, Tabs, Split and Card share the rest by weight.

weight.description: Flex weight inside a Row or Column.

selectionOf.description: Terminal extension: resolve relative paths in this subtree against the item selected in this List.

Row.description: Children side by side, widths by weight.
